title: MemoryRecordsCreateResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "record_id": string, "revision": int }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.records.create (§7.16): NOT_AUTHORIZED, INVALID_INPUT, SPACE_FROZEN, SUBJECT_FENCED, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
